usedFor: Shopify takes orders and RotaCloud schedules staff, so “New Order” can feed “Create Shift”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Create Shift” in RotaCloud
bestTemplate.why: A new order adds a shift in RotaCloud for the people who will handle it.

watchOut: “Delete a User” removes a RotaCloud user by ID, so never attach it to a Shopify trigger.
